description: Declarative remediation routes. Every fact type emitted by probes 01-12 maps to at least one rule; unmatched facts fall through to R-UNKNOWN (task dispatch) and are counted so coverage is measurable, never assumed.

risk_classes.auto-safe: no sudo, no remote mutation, idempotent — executable by remediate.sh with APPLY=1
risk_classes.gated: sudo/remote/edge mutation — execute via bootstrap APPLY=1, CI approval gate, or manually with the printed steps
risk_classes.human: decision required — task board row with the full route written out

rules.title: Lock .env permissions to 0600
steps: if [ -f "$REPO/.env" ]; then chmod 600 "$REPO/.env"; echo '.env locked 0600'; else echo '.env absent — nothing to lock'; fi

rules.title: Lock age keys.txt permissions to 0600
steps: if [ -f "$HOME/.config/nexo/age/keys.txt" ]; then chmod 600 "$HOME/.config/nexo/age/keys.txt"; echo 'keys.txt locked 0600'; else echo 'no keys.txt on this host'; fi

rules.title: Strip embedded credentials from git remote URLs (push -u token leak)
steps: if git -C "$REPO" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | grep -q '://[^/ ]*:[^@ ]*@'; then git -C "$REPO" remote set-url origin "https://github.com/ajdhoward/acidwurx-nexus.git" && echo 'origin reset to clean URL'; else echo 'origin already clean or absent'; fi
if grep -q x-access-token "$REPO/.git/config" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'WARNING: token still in .git/config — inspect manually'; else echo '.git/config clean'; fi

rules.title: Token-embedded URL parked in .git/config (from `git push -u <url>`) — reset branch upstream to origin
steps: if git -C "$REPO" config --get branch.main.remote 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^http'; then git -C "$REPO" config branch.main.remote origin && git -C "$REPO" config branch.main.merge refs/heads/main && echo 'branch.main upstream reset to origin'; else echo 'branch upstream already clean'; fi

if grep -qE '(ghp_|gho_|github_pat_|cfut_|cfat_)' "$REPO/.git/config" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'WARNING: token pattern still present in .git/config — open it and remove the credential, then rotate the token'; else echo '.git/config token-free'; fi

rules.title: Install fleet SSH host aliases (fixes 'Could not resolve hostname jessicafletcher')
steps: mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh" && touch "$HOME/.ssh/config" && chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/config"

grep -q 'nexo-fleet-aliases' "$HOME/.ssh/config" || printf '
# nexo-fleet-aliases (managed block — do not edit inside)
Host markslone
  HostName 192.168.1.179
Host jessicafletcher
  HostName 192.168.1.138
Host barryslone
  HostName 192.168.1.186
Host tanyacheex
  HostName 192.168.1.164
Host sharon
  HostName 192.168.1.1
  User root
# nexo-fleet-aliases-end
' >> "$HOME/.ssh/config"

rules.title: Scrub token-shaped strings from shell history + rotate the exposed credentials
steps: sed -i.bak -E 's/(ghp_|cfut_|cfat_|sk-or-v1-|AGE-SECRET-KEY-1)[A-Za-z0-9_+\/=-]{10,}/\1[REDACTED]/g' "$HOME/.bash_history" "$HOME/.zsh_history" 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'Then rotate every credential that ever touched this shell (see R-ROTATION routes)'

rules.title: Complete credential rotation: {item}
steps: Rotate at the provider (CF dashboard / service UI), update .env + GitHub Actions secret, then mark done: export {marker}=1 in .env
rules.notes: Archive-leaked credential set; rotation is mandatory before production apply.

rules.title: Hydrate CF_API_TOKEN (+CF_ACCOUNT_ID/CF_ZONE_ID) in .env to enable probes 01/08 and the edge plane
steps: Create token at CF dashboard (Zero Trust + DNS + Workers edit), then: edit $REPO/.env

rules.title: Hydrate GITHUB_TOKEN in .env to enable probes 04/09 + push flows
steps: PAT scopes: repo + workflow (classic). gh auth token can supply it: export GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token)

rules.title: Install sops (+age) for encrypted-blob workflows
steps: sudo apt install -y sops age   # Debian family
sudo pacman -S --needed sops age   # Arch family

rules.title: Optional tool '{value}' absent on {node} — install when a workflow needs it
steps: echo 'Resolve the {value} package for this distro (some tools need vendor repos: gh -> official apt repo/AUR, bw -> Bitwarden CLI release, restic/age/tmux -> distro main)'
rules.notes: Low severity: absence only matters when a dependent workflow runs; recorded so the fact is never silently dropped.

rules.title: Rebind Ollama to loopback (T-002; Law 5)
steps: sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d
printf '[Service]\nEnvironment="OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434"\n' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/loopback.conf
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart ollama

rules.title: Disable or mesh-restrict xrdp (T-003)
steps: sudo systemctl disable --now xrdp xrdp-sesman 2>/dev/null || true

rules.title: Mask rpcbind unless NFS is required
steps: sudo systemctl mask --now rpcbind.socket rpcbind.service 2>/dev/null || true

rules.title: Bind :9090 service (cockpit/prometheus-class) to loopback or mesh-only
steps: echo 'Identify owner: ss -tulpnH | grep :9090 — then set its listen address to 127.0.0.1 or the mesh IP'

rules.title: Decide Plex exposure: disable remote/DLNA or move behind tunnel+Access
steps: Plex Settings > Network: disable remote access; or retire Plex in favour of the jellyfin catalog profile

rules.title: Thermal ceiling exceeded ({value}C) — airflow/dust/paste check before sustained inference
steps: Physical inspection; re-test under load: watch -n5 'cat /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp'

rules.title: Pin static DHCP lease for jessicafletcher (.138) on sharon — ends the .138/.139 drift
steps: ssh root@192.168.1.1 "uci add_list dhcp.lan.static_lease='AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF,192.168.1.138' # substitute real MAC from probe 07 leases; uci commit dhcp; /etc/init.d/dnsmasq restart"
rules.notes: MAC is captured by probe 07 leases — substitute before running.

rules.title: Gateway WARP down — restart wgcf + policy routing on markslone
steps: ssh markslone 'sudo wg-quick down wgcf 2>/dev/null; sudo wg-quick up wgcf; sudo /usr/local/bin/acidwurx-setup-routing.sh'
ssh markslone "curl -4 -s --interface wgcf https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace | grep -E 'ip=|warp='"
rules.notes: If handshake fails: rotate endpoints 162.159.193.1:2408 <-> 162.159.192.1:2408; check ISP UDP-2408 block.

rules.title: Client egress is direct-ISP (warp=off) — expected until Stage 9 applies the gateway play (DHCP option-3 redirect + wgcf)
steps: Pre-apply: no action. Post-apply: verify sharon uci dhcp_option contains 3,192.168.1.179 and lease renewed (30m window).

rules.title: Policy-routing rules absent on gateway — re-apply the routing manager
steps: ssh markslone 'sudo /usr/local/bin/acidwurx-setup-routing.sh && ip rule show | head -8'

rules.title: Fleet node {name} unreachable — diagnose: SSH trust vs host down, then WoL
steps: ping -c1 -W2 {ip} >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{name}: host UP — this is SSH key trust, not a power problem' || echo '{name}: host DOWN — WoL or physical power needed'
test -f "$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub" || ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' -f "$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
ssh-copy-id -i "$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub" adam@{ip}   # ONE-TIME interactive password (credential provisioning — the sanctioned exception to zero-prompt)
curl -s -X POST http://192.168.1.179:9000/wake -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"mac":"<MAC from probe 07 leases>"}'   # WoL relay (post Stage-9)

ssh root@192.168.1.1 'command -v wol >/dev/null 2>&1 && wol <MAC from probe 07 leases> || (command -v etherwake >/dev/null 2>&1 && etherwake <MAC>) || echo install: apk add wol'   # router-side WoL fallback (relay not yet deployed)
sleep 45; ping -c2 {ip}
rules.notes: BatchMode ssh failing on ALL nodes almost always means key trust was never provisioned (first wave). Run the ssh-copy-id pass once per node; probes 06/07, fleet_backup and fleet_apply all depend on it.

rules.title: {count} failed systemd unit(s) on {node}: {list}
steps: ssh {node} 'systemctl --failed; systemctl status <unit> -l --no-pager | head -20'

rules.title: isolcpus not active on compute node — re-run compute play + schedule reboot
steps: cd $REPO/infra/ansible && ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini playbook.yml --limit compute
sudo reboot   # isolation only takes effect on boot

rules.title: Hugepages below 512 on {node} — apply live (Law 3 floor)
steps: ssh {node} 'sudo sysctl -w vm.nr_hugepages=512'

rules.title: Disk {mount} at {value} on {node} — reclaim or expand
steps: du -xh --max-depth=2 / | sort -h | tail -15
journalctl --vacuum-size=100M
docker system prune -f / podman system prune -f (host-appropriate)

rules.title: {count} data mount(s) without noatime — fstab edit + remount
steps: Edit /etc/fstab options for the flagged mounts, then: sudo mount -o remount <target>

rules.title: SMART health FAILED on {device} ({node}) — back up NOW, plan replacement
steps: ./nexo.sh backup (fleet configs) + restic full run against the affected data
smartctl -a {device} for the failure attributes

rules.title: Restic repository not configured — initialize the backup target
steps: Set RESTIC_REPOSITORY + RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE in .env, then: restic init && ./nexo.sh backup

rules.title: barryslone unreachable — check WoL persistence unit / spin-down window
steps: ping -c2 192.168.1.186 || echo 'hdparm 15-min spin-down may need WoL first; wake via relay'

rules.title: {count} DNS record(s) expose private/CGNAT space (Law 5) — review then delete
steps: List from probe 08 data.dns_violations, confirm none are intentional, then delete via dashboard or API PATCH/DELETE

rules.title: Duplicate AI gateways {value} — consolidate onto 'acidwurx' (one billable entrypoint)
steps: Move consumers to https://gateway.ai.cloudflare.com/v1/$CF_ACCOUNT_ID/acidwurx/compat, verify logs, then delete {value} in dashboard

rules.title: {count} workers on the account — inventory & cull against the £5 cap
steps: probe 08 workers_detail is the inventory; delete dead scripts via wrangler delete <name> after confirming no routes reference them

rules.title: Private route 192.168.1.0/24 not advertised through the tunnel — run the edge apply
steps: Approve the production-bare-metal gate on the iac-cd run (pulumi up creates ZeroTrustTunnelRoute), or locally: cd infra/pulumi && pulumi up

rules.title: Stage-7 approval environment missing — create production-bare-metal with required reviewer BEFORE secrets
steps: Repo Settings > Environments > New environment: production-bare-metal > Required reviewers: ajdhoward

rules.title: main branch unprotected — enable after first green run (PR + status checks + signed commits)
steps: Repo Settings > Branches > Add rule for main

rules.title: {gap}
steps: Repo Settings > Secrets > Actions > New repository secret (value per .env / rotation runbook)

rules.title: Add fleet A-records to AdGuard Home so hostnames resolve LAN-wide (ssh jessicafletcher NXDOMAIN fix)
steps: AdGuard Home UI > Filters > DNS rewrites (or custom rules): markslone->192.168.1.179, jessicafletcher->192.168.1.138, barryslone->192.168.1.186, tanyacheex->192.168.1.164, sharon->192.168.1.1
Verify from any node: getent hosts jessicafletcher

rules.title: Espressif device {ip} ({mac}) — stage for ESPHome/OpenWrt firmware workflow
steps: ./nexo.sh launch deploy esphome (workbench on markslone:6052)
Adopt device in ESPHome dashboard; keep OTA on mesh-only VLAN if created

rules.title: Ollama profile context below 8192 — raise num_ctx for qwen2.5-coder:7b
steps: ollama run qwen2.5-coder:7b --num-ctx 8192 (or set in Modelfile PARAMETER num_ctx 8192)

rules.title: Stage-10 task server not wired into agent clients — print the config snippet
steps: sed -n '1,40p' "$REPO/docs/MCP_TASKS.md"

fallback.title: Unrouted finding: {type}={value} on {node} — triage and extend rules.json
steps: Inspect the source probe JSON in the run directory, then add a rule to tools/remediation/rules.json so this outcome is covered next wave (target: >=95% routed).
